description: Convert a file from a public http or https URL and save the result in output_dir on this computer. The switchfile server downloads the file itself, so nothing is uploaded from this computer. The result is named after the last part of the URL path with the target extension. Existing files are never replaced unless overwrite is true. Returns the saved paths and sizes, credits used and notes.

options.description: Conversion settings, for example {"quality": 80} or {"video_codec": "x264", "crf": 23}. Call list_formats with from and to to see the options of a pair. Leave out for automatic settings.

output_dir.description: Directory for the result. Created if missing.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file with the same name. Default false.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, in seconds (default 600). If the conversion is still running then, the answer contains the conversion id for get_conversion.

to.description: Target format as a file extension, for example pdf or mp4.

url.description: Public http or https URL of the file.

name: convert_url
title: Convert a file from a URL
